items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: Well, we call him P.J. Alexander.

ctx.x: Yeah, he died. He's got a son who lives in Baltimore, Maryland. What's his son's name? Well, we call him P.J. Alexander. Now what that P.J. stands for, I don't know. Well, it could be Peter Junior.
